questionEn: How to distinguish a pure substance from a mixture if there is no laboratory?
questionUz: Laboratoriya bo'lmasa, sof moddani aralashmadan qanday ajratish mumkin?
choicesEn: By color - pure are always colorless
By constant boiling or melting point
By smell - the mixtures do not smell
Mixtures are always heavier than water
choicesUz: Rangi bo'yicha - toza har doim rangsiz
Doimiy qaynash yoki erish nuqtasi bilan
